title: The Sleepy Haunts' 'BLOOM' is an album of self discovery and growing pains
htmlContent: The Sleepy Haunts are back with their captivating new album, BLOOM, which takes listeners on a heartfelt journey through the ups and downs of growing up. Over 39 minutes, the album dives into feelings of self discovery, challenges of independence, and the struggles we all face as we transition into adulthood. It starts with "why do I feel this way" setting a reflective mood and inviting everyone to join the lead singer on her search for answers about life. This track captures the confusion and uncertainty we often feel when trying to make sense of our emotions. The theme of vulnerability continues with "twenty," a touching track that speaks to those dealing with new responsibilities and the pressure to meet expectations. The Sleepy Haunts show their talent for blending feelings of doubt and strength. https://open.spotify.com/album/5PbpmLIMA4NWInDNLOqbJ1?si=GVIou3nAQ8CcloDgR5mJkA Standout songs like "why do I feel this way" and "tolerate it" offer honest and powerful insights into mental health and establishing personal boundaries, making the album relatable for many listeners. Each song highlights the joy of discovering ourselves and the exhaustion that can come with it. At 12 tracks, BLOOM tells a rich and impactful story that connects with anyone looking for authenticity. Follow on: Instagram
